title: CritiqueRecord
description: One blind critique of one candidate. The Critic sees candidates, not generator reasoning. Single writer: Critic (Critique). Append-only; a correction is a new record referencing this one.

id.description: Record id: a lower-case type prefix, a hyphen, at least three digits. Unique within a run.

ledger_version.description: The ledger version this record was written against. A CandidateRecord citing a version other than the frozen one is rejected by the Scribe.

references.description: Ids of the records this one is derived from or responds to. Never edit those records; reference them.

failure_modes.description: Ranked, most damaging first. Empty when the verdict is pass.

derivable.description: True if the candidate could have been deduced from the ledger without the technique. Derivable candidates lose to B0 by construction.

falsified_premise_claims.description: Ledger premises this critique claims are false. Any entry re-enters Frame.

verdict.description: pass is the expected outcome; return only for material defects. The return rate is tracked and the Critic recalibrated above roughly 40 per cent.
